output.title: BR-04 printed USD lines add up to the subtotal, each line rounded in the invoice currency before tax @critical
output.data_choice: P-1130 is billed in USD at 1.0835 and has three billable October lines (1,200.00, 960.00 and 270.00 EUR after the 2.1 hours round up to 2.25). Writing lines 1 and 2 up by 0.07 EUR leaves each converted line about 0.004 USD below its rounded value, and line 3 (292.545) leaves 0.005. Summing the rounded lines gives 2,633.07, while rounding only the total, as BILL-1121 did, gives 2,633.06, so the defect would show again.
scenario: Create a proposal for projects.polarReporting with period end PERIOD_END and the invoice date left at the period end
Write up line 1 by 0.07 with the reason 'Rounding check'
Write up line 2 by 0.07 with the reason 'Rounding check'
Read the currency, the exchange rate and the line count
Read line 3's date and quantity, the amounts of lines 1, 2 and 3, and the tax on each line
Read the subtotal, the tax and the total
Accept the confirmation dialog and delete the proposal
